item.title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin A Texas lawmaker filed a bill Monday that would let each city and county in the state invest up to $10 million of public money in bitcoin or another cryptocurrency, without setting any rules for how those coins would be held. House Bill 815, filed by Rep. Ron Reynolds, a Missouri City Democrat, on the first day of prefiling for the 90th Texas Legislature, carries the caption “Relating to the authority of a municipality or county to invest money in cryptocurrencies.” The introduced text , posted on the Texas Legislature’s site, is two sections long. The bill would amend the Public Funds Investment Act, Chapter 2256 of the Texas Government Code, by adding a new Section 2256.0165, titled “Authorized Investments: Cryptocurrency.” Under that section, “a municipality or county may invest not more than $10 million of its money or money under its control in Bitcoin or another cryptocurrency.” The authority would take effect Sept. 1, 2027, if the bill becomes law. The $10 million figure is a cap on each city or county, not a single statewide pool. School districts and other local governments covered by the investment act are left out. What the bill does and does not say The measure borrows its definitions of “Bitcoin” and “cryptocurrency” from Section 403.701 of the Government Code, the definitions written into law last year by Senate Bill 21, which created the Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve . Bitcoin is defined as a decentralized cryptocurrency created by a peer-to-peer network that operates independently of any central authority or bank. Cryptocurrency is defined more broadly as a virtual currency that uses cryptography to secure transactions recorded on a distributed ledger, such as a blockchain. That means a city or county would not be limited to bitcoin. The bill also does not import the reserve law’s requirement that coins bought for the state fund have an average market capitalization of at least $500 billion over the most recent 24-month period, or its provisions on cold storage and qualified custodians. The Public Funds Investment Act already requires local governments to adopt a written investment policy that emphasizes safety of principal and liquidity, and to invest with the care a prudent person would use in managing their own affairs. A city or county would still have to add cryptocurrency to that policy before buying any. The new section itself is silent on custody, on audits specific to digital assets, and on how a loss would be handled. A narrower version of last year’s proposal Reynolds filed a broader measure, House Bill 4258, on March 10, 2025, with Rep. Mihaela Plesa. That bill would have let the comptroller invest as much as $250 million of the Economic Stabilization Fund, the state’s rainy day fund, in bitcoin or another cryptocurrency, and it included the same $10 million cap for cities and counties. item.title: Sanwo-Olu appoints Akinyemi as acting MD LAWMA
item.description: .Reviews management structure By Olasunkanmi Akoni Lagos State Governor, Babajide Sanwo-Olu has finally appointed Olajuwon Akinyemi as the acting Managing Director of the Lagos State Waste Management Authority, LAWMA. By the appointment, Akinyemi succeeded former M.D, Dr. Muyiwa Gbadegesin who was forced to resign following intractable waste management challenges across the state. When contacted, the state Commissioner for the Environment and Water Resources, Tokunbo Wahab, on Tuesday evening, confirmed the appointment. According to Wahab, the new MD, who was the former Executive Director of Operations, will also serve in the capacity of Executive Director, Finance. Also, in the coming days, new officers would be redeployed in the restructuring effort of the management staff. This comes following reports of forced resignation of former M.D, Dr. Muyiwa Gbadegesin over the seemingly intractable waste management challenges across the state. This laid to rest earlier reported appointment of , Dr. Hassan Sanuth, Director Sanitation Services – Office of Environment in the Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources as acting MD. However, Sanuth was temporarily drafted to LAWMA to assist in waste management pending appointment of substantive managing director. On October 19, indications emerged that Governor Sanwo-Olu has directed Gbadegesin to resign amid persistent refuse accumulation across the state. It was gathered that the governor became increasingly dissatisfied with Gbadegesin’s handling of the waste management crisis and had asked him to step down. Earlier in September 2026, during an inspection of the Olusosun Dumpsite in Ojota, Sanwo-Olu handed a strong warning against further failure to stop the menace announcing plans to overhaul the agency for effective management, describing Gbadegesin’s inability as “sabotage” According to an inside source, “the governor’s displeasure stemmed from the slow pace of waste evacuation and the alleged failure of Gbadegesin to act promptly on directives aimed at addressing the crisis. “The governor was at the Olusosun Dumpsite in Ojota a month ago and was dissatisfied with the state of things. He gave instructions that immediate action be taken on the matter, as he has declared a state of emergency on waste management. “The governor was upset when he observed that the situation had not improved despite his clear directive. So, over the weekend, he asked him to resign, although he is begging and has reached out to some prominent Lagosians to beg on his behalf.” Also, residents across Lagos have repeatedly complained about worsening waste collection, with refuse accumulating along road medians, streets and major highways. The prevalent parts of the state, include: Ogba, Idimu, Ejigbo, Mushin, Egbeda, Surulere, Ajegunle, Ikorodu, Ojo, Obalende, Apapa and Mile 2, where residents have had to contend with heaps of stinking refuse along streets and drainage channels. item.title: Undefeated Middletown football team out of Section 9 final due to eligibility issue
item.description: Middletown has been removed from the Section 9 Class AA football playoffs after it was forced to forfeit its semifinal win due to an eligibility issue. (Jim Franco/Times Union) (Jim Franco/Times Union) An issue surrounding the use of an ineligible player has thrown the Section 9 Class AA football playoffs into chaos ahead of this weekend's sectional championships. Middletown, which boasted an undefeated record after its sectional semifinal win over Valley Central this past weekend, had been scheduled to face Newburgh Free Academy for the Section 9 title this coming Saturday, but has since forfeited that win for using an ineligible player. According to a letter posted to the Enlarged City School District of Middletown's website signed by superintendent Amy Creeden and athletic director Justin Sturge, in the aftermath of Middletown's 48-15 win over Valley Central, "a question was raised regarding whether one of our varsity football players met postseason eligibility requirements." After reviewing the situation with Section 9 officials, it was confirmed that the unidentified player did not meet the minimum requirement of participating in three regular-season games to be eligible for the postseason. The letter called the issue an "unintentional adult error in understanding the rules," and the district immediately requested a waiver from Section 9, which was denied. The district then appealed to the state high school athletic association, but the appeal was also denied. Due to the forfeit, Middletown's record has been dropped to 9-1 and Valley Central has been inserted into Saturday's Section 9 Class AA final against Newburgh. "We want to be very clear: this was an error made by adults, not our scholars," the letter reads. "Not one student-athlete did anything wrong." In a statement to the Times Union, NYSPHSAA Executive Director Robert Zayas said: "NYSPHSAA recognizes the disappointment and frustration surrounding the circumstances involving the Middletown varsity football program, particularly for the student-athletes who have worked hard throughout an outstanding season. "The rules and eligibility standards of NYSPHSAA are established and approved by our member schools through the Association's formal governance process. As Executive Director, my authority is defined by the NYSPHSAA Constitution and Handbook, and any exceptions to established rules must be consistent with the provisions approved by our membership. "While we recognize the circumstances surrounding this violation, NYSPHSAA has a responsibility to ensure the consistent and equitable application of its rules and eligibility standards across all member schools. According to the letter on the district website, the Middletown school district "is actively working with legal counsel to pursue further legal recourse on our team's behalf. This is a fluid situation. We want to be honest that the chances are limited, but our young people deserve every effort we can make for them, and we will ma

item.title: Grade the trade: Vikings get a throwback QB, deal with Raiders for old friend Kirk Cousins
item.description: After Monday night, the Minnesota Vikings knew they had to try to get a quarterback. They landed a familiar face. The Vikings traded for Kirk Cousins, who spent six of his 15 NFL seasons in Minnesota. They sent a third-round pick to the Raiders for the 38-year-old quarterback, via ESPN . That should start the Fernando Mendoza era in Las Vegas, while giving the Vikings hope for fixing their offense and winning the NFC North. Here are the grades for the trade: Vikings trade for Kirk Cousins Usually, viable quarterbacks aren’t available in trade. Credit to the Vikings for getting a deal done. After Minnesota watched Carson Wentz flounder around on Monday night, and after the team realized Kyler Murray wouldn’t be the answer, a bold move was needed. Cousins has played pretty well this season, with 20 touchdowns and eight interceptions. He can come right in and run Kevin O’Connell’s offense, which made him more valuable to Minnesota than some other teams. Kirk Cousins is coming back to the Vikings for a second stint with the team. (Photo by Thearon W. Henderson/Getty Images) Thearon W. Henderson via Getty Images The Vikings weren’t going to be a Super Bowl contender with a treacherous quarterback situation. Cousins might not completely change that — he’s still by far the fourth-best quarterback in a tough division — but it’s well worth the price of a third-round pick to find out. Grade: B Raiders get a valuable pick The Raiders played the Kirk Cousins/Fernando Mendoza situation perfectly, as it turns out. They paid Cousins and gave him the first nine games of the season. With the Raiders slipping to 4-5 and their playoff hopes becoming more unrealistic, it was about time to turn the offense over to Mendoza anyway. So the Raiders paid for half of a season from Cousins and got a third-round pick out of it in the end. That’s really smart business. The Raiders might have Aidan O’Connell start for a few games if they truly don’t think Mendoza, the first overall pick, is ready. Either way, Las Vegas was playing chess with how it got a valuable top-100 pick for a 38-year-old quarterback who was probably going to start only a few more games anyway. Grade: A

item.title: Real Madrid eye 24-year-old Brighton ace as potential replacement for veteran superstar – report
item.description: Real Madrid eye 24-year-old Brighton ace as potential replacement for veteran superstar – report According to TeamTalk (h/t Bernabeu Digital ), Real Madrid have identified Brighton & Hove Albion goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen as a potential replacement for veteran superstar Thibaut Courtois. The Spanish capital club are closely monitoring the Netherlands international’s progress as they begin planning for the long-term future of their goalkeeping position. Courtois still remains a key figure Courtois remains a key figure at Real Madrid and continues to be an important part of Jose Mourinho’s squad at the Santiago Bernabeu. At 34 years old, the Belgian shot-stopper continues to remain one of the best goalkeepers in the business. In the ongoing season, he has played 15 appearances across all competitions, keeping four clean sheets and conceding 16 goals. His performances have been clutch in the team maintaining an impressive run of form under Mourinho. Still a key figure at Real Madrid. (Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images) While his current contract expires in 2027, a new one-year extension is already in the works for the veteran goalkeeper. However, Real Madrid are already laying the groundwork for life beyond their ace goalkeeper as they wish to be prepared with a succession plan rather than searching for a replacement when it becomes an immediate necessity. Bart Verbruggen the chosen one? As such, Real Madrid have identified Verbruggen as their most preferred candidate to take over from Courtois in the long run. The 24-year-old Dutchman’s age, physical presence, reliability between the posts and ability to contribute to build-up play make him an appealing option. Verbruggen’s contract expires in 2028. (Photo by Naomi Baker/Getty Images) Meanwhile, as per the report, the Netherlands goalkeeper would find it difficult to turn down a concrete offer from Real Madrid. However, the biggest obstacle for Los Blancos will be the position taken by Brighton & Hove Albion. They do not want to let go of the 24-year-old and see him as a key part of their project. But the summer of 2027 could provide a window of opportunity for Real Madrid. Verbruggen’s contract with the Seagulls expires in 2028, meaning he would be entering the final year of his deal at the end of the current season. If a new contract is not negotiated, he could become available for a reasonable price and Brighton could be forced to sell in order to avoid losing him for free when his deal runs out.

item.title: Patriots Power Rankings Roundup: Where New England Landed After Week 9
item.description: Patriots Power Rankings Roundup: Where New England Landed After Week 9 originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New England Patriots suffered a disappointing loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 9, falling 45-27 at Gillette Stadium. The defeat dropped New England to 5-4 on the season and raised questions about the team's ability to compete with some of the NFL's top contenders. Drake Maye threw three interceptions in the loss, while the Patriots defense struggled to contain Jordan Love and the Packers offense. New England will look to bounce back Sunday against the Detroit Lions in Munich, Germany, but the loss caused the Patriots to slide in several national power rankings. Patriots Power Rankings Roundup ESPN : No. 14 The Patriots dropped from No. 11 to No. 14 in ESPN's latest rankings. Mike Reiss pointed to New England's Week 13 matchup against the Buffalo Bills as a more significant test for the team's division-title hopes than its upcoming game against Detroit. The Athletic : No. 14 The Athletic also moved New England down three spots, from No. 11 to No. 14. Chad Graff and Josh Kendall raised concerns about the production of some of New England's highest-paid players as Christian Gonzalez had "the worst game of his career," while A.J. Brown continues to be sidelined with knee and ankle injuries. The Sporting News : No. 14 Writer Vinnie Iyer dropped the Patriots from No. 10 to No. 14 in The Sporting News' rankings. He also made an eye-opening observation about Drake Maye's interceptions, noting the quarterback has thrown nine in four losses compared to just two in five wins. Bleacher Report : No. 13 Bleacher Report pointed to New England's inconsistent play as writer Brent Sobleski dropped the Patriots from No. 11 to No. 13, citing their recent defensive struggles and difficult stretch of upcoming opponents. Pro Football Talk : No. 14 The Patriots moved from No. 10 to No. 14. Mike Florio offered a brief assessment of the Patriots' recent not-so-stellar outing: "The regression continues." USA Today : No. 10 Nate Davis handed the Patriots the biggest drop in his rankings, sliding them five spots from No. 5 to No. 10, though he still kept New England in the top 10. He also noted that the Patriots allowed 45 points at home for the first time since 1970. item.title: 49ers add wide receiver Keenan Allen in trade with Colts as deadline approaches
item.description: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen (10) catches a pass in front of Dallas Cowboys' Malik Hooker (24) andn Daron Bland (26) during the first half of an NFL football game in Indianapolis, Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. (AP Photo/Jeff Roberson) (Jeff Roberson/Associated Press) On Tuesday, two weeks after the San Francisco 49ers acquired a 30-something from the Colts, they acquired another 30-something from Indianapolis in an all-in Super Bowl push. The 49ers traded a 2027 sixth-round pick to the Colts for wide receiver Keenan Allen, 34, after dealing a 2027 fourth-rounder to Indianapolis for defensive tackle DeForest Buckner, 32, a league source said. The 49ers have five picks in next year's draft: a first-, second-, third-, fifth- and seventh-rounder. With the 49ers dealing with a host of wide receiver injuries, most notably to six-time Pro Bowl selection Mike Evans, they dealt for Allen, a six-time Pro Bowl pick who has 40 catches for 351 yards and a touchdown in eight games this season. Allen, a 14-year veteran who attended Cal, is an elite route-runner who ranks second among active players in receptions (1,095), fourth in receiving yards (12,402) and fifth in receiving touchdowns (71). Allen, of course, is in his career twilight. The 49ers will be his fourth team since he was traded from the Chargers to the Bears for a fourth-round pick in March 2024. Since his last Pro Bowl season in 2023, he has 191 catches for 1,872 yards and 12 touchdowns in 40 games, averaging 9.8 yards per catch. Sporting a 7-1 record, the 49ers grabbed Allen about two hours before Tuesday's 1 p.m. trade deadline with Evans, 33, dealing with Achilles tendinitis that's sidelined him since he was forced to exit a win against the Commanders on Oct. 19. This is a breaking story. Check back for updates. Subscribe There’s more to San Francisco with the Chronicle. Subscribe today for just 25¢. item.title: Video catches USC announcer's take on targeting call
item.description: He said what? That’s what many were asking regarding longtime USC football radio play-by-play announcer Pete Arbogast’s reaction to Oregon quarterback Dante Moore being knocked out of Saturday’s 41-27 Ducks’ victory at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. The play occurred in the second quarter when Moore scrambled and slid. USC linebacker Desman Stephens II then put his shoulder into Moore’s head, knocking him backward into the turf. Moore lay on the field for several minutes before being taken off on a cart and loaded into an ambulance. Stephens celebrated the hit even after being flagged, leading to a skirmish with several Oregon players. Meanwhile, up in the radio booth, Arbogast said the play did not appear to be targeting and claimed Moore didn’t slide feet-first. Arbogast went on to claim that Stephens went in helmet first and ran into Moore who “ducked into that hit.” “I saw him dive forward,” Arbogast claimed. Radio analyst Shaun Cody, who played defensive line at USC (2001-2004) and spent eight seasons in the NFL (Detroit and Houston), clearly disagreed. “He’s laying feet first,” Cody responded. But Arbogast countered, “Well, he is now because they spun him around.” Cody disagreed again, and Arbogast said he wanted to see the replay, which clearly showed Moore sliding feet-first and Stephens going in head-first, with his right shoulder striking Moore in the head. “Yeah, not a feet-first slide, it’s more of a knee slide,” Arbogast claimed while watching the replay. While it’s one thing not to see clearly a live play from high up in a radio booth, it’s another to watch the replay and claim to see something that didn’t exist. Footage from the USC radio team in the Oregon game 😂😂😂 i can’t believe this is real pic.twitter.com/82HYans8Y9 — Adam Breneman (@AdamBreneman81) September 29, 2026 Cody immediately smirked at Arbogast’s viewpoint; then Arbogast added, “It didn’t look like targeting on the replay to us.” In response, Cody looked directly into the camera, eyes wide, and nodded, clearly disagreeing with Arbogast’s assessment. Homerism? Maybe. Potential advertising fodder for local optometrists to encourage thousands to update their eyeglass prescriptions? Absolutely. Oregon backup quarterback Dylan Raiola replaced Moore and passed for 289 yards and two touchdowns in the win. Moore was later diagnosed with a concussion; he has entered concussion protocol and will be out indefinitely . Moore released a statement saying he would soon return. No. 15 Oregon (3-1, 1-0 Big Ten) hosts No. 23 UCLA (4-0, 2-0) at 12:30 p.m. on Oct. 10. item.title: Damian Lillard is back and Ja Morant is here. How exactly is this going to work? | Bill Oram
item.description: In the history of basketball, we have certainly seen some why-would-they-do-that? pairings. Jerseys and sleeves. Kawhi Leonard and a tree sponsorship. Utah and “the Jazz.” Once, there was even Detlef Schrempf and a headband, if you can believe that. Ja Morant and Damian Lillard? We’re about to find out if they belong on such a list. Because of all the things you might have said the Trail Blazers needed as they prepared to welcome Lillard back after making a playoff run without him, a slight-of-stature ball-dominant guard with a questionable jump shot would not have topped anyone’s list. Depth on the wing? Yes. Shooting? Definitely. Defense? Always. Morant doesn’t particularly address any of those, and yet, he’s here, a dynamic two-time All-Star in need of a second act, being paid a team-high $42.1 million to play the same position as not just Lillard, but Jrue Holiday and Scoot Henderson. Heck, the Blazers’ most valuable point guard last season was forward Deni Avdija. “I’m sure there will be questions about fit,” General Manager Joe Cronin said Monday. Uh, yeah. The Blazers have little more than three weeks before the regular season begins in which to figure that out. At the team’s annual media day on Monday, Morant appeared in a fresh white No. 1 Trail Blazers jersey. It’s happening. “It’s easy for people to be like, ‘Man how is this going to work,’” Lillard offered. “‘They can’t do this, they can’t do that.’ But being on the floor with them … we can be a dangerous team and I really believe that.” The onus is on the Trail Blazers starting this month to prove that they bet right in acquiring Morant. And that pairing him with Lillard isn’t the boondoggle conventional wisdom suggests it will be. Lillard noted how many teams that succeeded in the playoffs last year, think San Antonio with its four point guards, relied on numerous playmakers. To his credit, Morant said he would be comfortable coming off the bench, if necessary. But they would not be the first NBA team to fall into the trap of believing they are capable of adjusting or that they will be comfortable sacrificing. It isn’t uncommon to see players in those situations default to familiar habits and sensibilities once the season is underway or struggles come. That’s what made a lot of the positive energy around what sure seems like an awkward roster ring so hollow. We’re going to need to see it to believe it. Morant tried to lay out a vision for how it could look. If he drives to the paint and is double-teamed, someone else is inevitably open. That’s how basketball works. “That allows me to have more space to be the best Ja I can be,” Morant said. The 36-year-old Holiday, who would be a more natural complement next to Lillard or Morant than they are to each other, made his own case for why the point guard rotation makes sense. “It’s about being a complete basketball player for myself,” he said, “and I think we have a lot of guys like that.” There is a long history of teams talking themselv

item.title: Red Wings GM Admits He Is Fielding Calls on Simon Edvinsson
item.description: On Tuesday, Detroit Red Wings interim general manager Shawn Horcoff attended his first NHL general managers meeting in Toronto. He is still carrying two difficult situations into it: Dylan Larkin is suspended without pay after leaving the team on Oct. 29, and Simon Edvinsson is still an unsigned restricted free agent. Horcoff would still rather sign Edvinsson than move him. Asked whether the standoff could soften that position, he told Nicholas J. Cotsonika of NHL.com , “I’d still like to sign Simon, but I think when it’s someone like that and the situation that we’re in, you can’t help but take calls. It’s my job to do what’s in the best interest of the Detroit Red Wings. I’m going to take all those calls and hear what people have to say.” Apr 11, 2026; Detroit, Michigan, USA; New Jersey Devils left wing Brian Halonen (48) skates with the puck defended by Detroit Red Wings center Andrew Copp (18) and defenseman Simon Edvinsson (77) in the third period at Little Caesars Arena. Mandatory Credit: Rick Osentoski-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Simon Edvinsson Has Until Dec. 1 to Sign Edvinsson has until Dec. 1 to sign a new contract with the Red Wings, or he cannot play this season. Last season he scored nine goals and recorded 16 assists in 72 games , along with a plus-minus rating of 12. He is only 23 years old, and with the cap space available to Detroit , it would be a failure if the Red Wings can’t get a long-term deal finished. Edvinsson Keeps Skating in Nashville Edvinsson has been seen skating in Nashville twice, in a Red Wings jersey. He told Nick Kieser of Lower Broad Pucks that Predators forward Filip Forsberg recommended a local coach to him, and that he is still hoping for something to get done soon . Cotsonika also wrote that Edvinsson reportedly wants to be traded, which keeps the Predators a name worth watching before Dec. 1. What Happens if Edvinsson Does Not Sign If Edvinsson is not playing anywhere this season, it would be interesting to see where Horcoff would take things. He may have to trade him before Dec. 1 if Edvinsson does not want to be here, even though Horcoff would like to keep him around for the long haul.

item.title: Real Madrid star opens the door to January exit
item.description: Real Madrid star opens the door to January exit Real Madrid star Endrick has admitted that he has not yet ruled out the possibility of departing Spain’s capital on loan during the winter transfer window. This comes amid a fresh round of speculation surrounding the name of the Brazilian international. Frontman Endrick has reemerged as a prominent figure in the transfer chatter across much of Europe over the last 24 hours. Amid a search for mid-season reinforcements up top, Premier League champions Arsenal are understood to have earmarked the 20-year-old as a potential loan signing. Endrick has continued to struggle for game-time at Real Madrid this season, despite being repeatedly backed by manager José Mourinho in public. Speaking during an exchange with the media on Tuesday, the young attacker was himself therefore drawn on the prospect of a 2nd successive winter loan move. And Endrick, as cited by Fabrizio Romano, went on to inform Brazilian journalist Cahê Mota: “I’m only 20, so I’ll see how things unfold. I just want to play, be happy, and help my teammates. “I don’t know what will happen in January; that’s in God’s hands. I only ask for what’s best for my career. Whatever is meant to happen, will happen. I’ll keep my feet on the ground and continue doing my absolute best. Madrid is a wonderful city, but I will always do whatever it takes to advance my career.” Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Seattle Seahawks 2026 trade deadline tracker
item.description: We’ve reached NFL and therefore Seattle Seahawks trade deadline week, which often promises to have some interesting deals and rarely actually materializes. Minor or mid-level deals have happened more recently on deadline day itself, so it’s not like we live in a “nothing happens” world. There have admittedly been prominent in-season trades already this year, including the Quenton Nelson and Jeffery Simmons trades just a couple of weeks ago, as well as Joey Porter Jr going to the Dallas Cowboys, and Marvin Harrison Jr heading for the Houston Texans. For the second year in a row, the trade deadline is during Week 10. The Seattle Seahawks are usually active during the deadline, and this year they’ve pulled off one major trade. Will John Schneider cook up another midseason masterclass like he did for Leonard Williams, Quandre Diggs, Carlos Dunlap, and other names from previous deadline deals? Follow Field Gulls’ trade tracker coverage throughout Monday and Tuesday, and we’ll see what the Seahawks will do as they look to get back on track after a sputtering 5-4 start. Have the Seattle Seahawks made any trades during the regular season? Yes. They acquired longtime Indianapolis Colts guard Quenton Nelson for a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-rounder. Who could the Seahawks potentially put on the trade block? No one immediately springs to mind. The likes of Dante Fowler Jr have rarely played this year but likely wouldn’t fetch much on the trade market. Emanuel Wilson being an unofficial healthy scratch is worth monitoring, although similarly he’s not much of a valuable trade piece, and Seattle may not want to risk moving any capable RB given the injury concerns on the depth chart. Which positions would the Seahawks potentially be most interested in? Edge rusher and wide receiver might be two positions of need for Seattle. Rashid Shaheed’s injury and generally underwhelming receiving stats could impact what Seattle does at receiver. The edge rushing room is essentially three deep, and with only Derick Hall and Connor O’Toole under contract beyond 2027, there might be some forward thinking required. The New York Jets’ Will McDonald IV has reportedly requested a trade and could be one to watch. When does the NFL trade deadline window close? At 4 pm ET/1 pm PT on Tuesday, Nov. 10. item.title: 76ers Undefeated In Clutch, But This Streak Is A Trap
item.description: Patrick Gorski-Imagn Images The Philadelphia 76ers have won every single close game they have played this season, but that perfect record might be the biggest problem they face. The team improved to 9-2 on the season after beating the Chicago Bulls 127-121 on Sunday, a victory that kept their clutch record at a flawless 8-0. While fans love the drama, the reality is that a roster full of aging stars cannot survive this much stress week after week. The 76ers have played eight clutch games so far, which is the most in the entire league by a wide margin, according to The Sixer Sense . LeBron James has a clear explanation for why the team stays cool when the clock winds down. He told reporters after the win that the squad simply does not panic under pressure. “We have a lot of guys that’s been in late-game situations, and we have a no-panic button,” James said. He added that the group understands they must get stops, but they also know how to stay calm if the other team goes on a run. This mindset has worked so far, but it masks a deeper issue with how the team plays for the full 48 minutes. The Danger of Constant Comebacks Winning tight games is a great trait to have, yet relying on it every night is a recipe for exhaustion. According to The Sixer Sense , the 76ers have recovered from deficits to secure victories far too frequently this season, even versus inferior opponents. A team that does not dominate early will eventually run out of gas, and this roster is not exactly young across the board. Although the 76ers must leverage their talent edge earlier, they repeatedly allow contests to reach the last possessions for a winner to emerge. This pattern is dangerous for a group that includes players like James and Joel Embiid who need rest. Shooting Stars in the Final Minutes The stats show just how well the offense clicks when the pressure is highest. In clutch time, the Sixers are outscoring opponents 86-67 while shooting 52.2% from the field, according to Crossing Broad. Tyrese Maxey contributed significantly to that success by recording 30 clutch points on 6-of-11 shooting plus 15-of-17 from the line with no turnovers. LeBron James also contributed 22 points in the win over the Bulls, marking his highest-scoring game as a 76er. Even though the numbers look great, the fact remains that they should not need to rely on such high-pressure finishes to get Ws. The 76ers will need to find a way to start strong and keep that level of play for the whole game if they want to avoid burning out. The team has the firepower to put away opponents early, yet they keep finding themselves in tense moments when their talent suggests they should be winning by double digits. Now 8-0 in games extending to crunch time, the 76ers possess a perfect record that remains notable despite growing clarity about the dangers of this strategy.

item.title: Rory McIlroy Takes Fresh Shot at Bryson DeChambeau Over 2027 Future
item.description: | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Ajayi Segun Rory McIlroy has taken another shot at Bryson DeChambeau while discussing the American’s uncertain future in professional golf. The Northern Irishman believes the former LIV Golf star does not have many options if he wants to continue playing competitive golf in 2027. DeChambeau has been left without a clear playing future following LIV Golf’s collapse , with the Saudi-backed league set to wind down its operations after failing to secure the funding needed to continue. The two-time U.S. Open champion now has to decide where he wants to play next season, with the DP World Tour offering him a possible route. McIlroy made the comments ahead of this week’s DP World Tour Championship in Dubai, where he is hoping to secure another Race to Dubai title. ALSO READ: Rory McIlroy Sends Strong Message to Golf Bosses Over Distance Rollback Rory McIlroy Gives Blunt Assessment of Bryson DeChambeau’s Options McIlroy was asked about DeChambeau and the possibility of him joining the DP World Tour in 2027. The 2025 Masters champion acknowledged that the American would bring attention to tournaments but also made it clear that his options were limited . Bryson DeChambeau. Mandatory Credit: Hamad I Mohammed/Reuters via Imagn Images “Yeah, look, I think a name like Bryson DeChambeau and everything he brings with him, good and bad, he brings eyeballs, which is a good thing for tournaments….” “And honestly, look, I’m certainly not in his shoes, and nor would I ever want to be but it doesn’t seem like he’s got many options. You know, if he wants to play competitive golf, it doesn’t seem like he’s got many options…” It is another interesting comment from McIlroy, who has not always seen eye to eye with DeChambeau. However, his latest remarks also show that he recognizes the attention the American could bring to the European circuit. DeChambeau is eligible for DP World Tour membership for the 2027 season following his victory at the 2024 U.S. Open. However, he has only six days left to make a decision on whether to take up the opportunity. The 32-year-old has yet to confirm his plans, although he has already committed to playing in the Nedbank Golf Challenge in South Africa in December. He also recently addressed LIV Golf’s collapse but did not reveal where he intends to compete beyond that appearance. McIlroy Eyes Another Race to Dubai Title While DeChambeau’s future remains uncertain, McIlroy has his own business to take care of in Dubai this week. The Northern Irishman enters the DP World Tour Championship second in the Race to Dubai standings and has another opportunity to finish the season on top. A victory this week would give him his fifth consecutive Race to Dubai title and eighth overall. That would also see him equal Colin Montgomerie’s record of eight season-long titles. item.title: Here’s What Malik Nabers Revealed After Fox Criticized His Attitude
item.description: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers has entered a heated public dispute with Fox Sports broadcasters following the team’s 19-11 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday. During the game, play-by-play announcer Joe Davis and analyst Greg Olsen criticized Nabers for his demeanor, with Davis stating the player’s body language “has been terrible today”. Nabers responded quickly on social media, taking to an Instagram story to call out the commentators for their assessment. Defending the Stoic Look The core of the argument centers on whether a player must show emotion to be a good teammate. Olsen had suggested that great receivers must demand the ball, noting, “There’s never been a great wide receiver who hasn’t demanded the ball”, according to ESPN . However, he also warned that being demanding should never hurt the team’s success. Nabers rejected the idea that his face changes based on the score. He insisted, “My face is the same way if I’m having a good game, bad, winning or losing”. Nabers clarified that his frustration was actually directed at his own team’s effort, not his teammates. He admitted he felt the offense was “lollygagging our way through the game”, according to Sports Illustrated . He explained that he was trying to “wake everybody up just to make sure we’re playing a game right now”. The receiver emphasized that in a division matchup, players must “go attack people, you have to go attack the game”. Coach Harbaugh Steps In Giants head coach John Harbaugh addressed the controversy during his media availability on Monday. He defended his player, pointing out that outsiders cannot see the full context of what happens on the field. Harbaugh asked, “If you really don’t know the person, or you don’t know the dynamic or you don’t know the circumstances or who the person’s talking to, how do you have any idea what the application is and how do you judge it?” The coach concluded that it is difficult for anyone outside the huddle to make a fair call on player behavior. He stated simply, “It’s really hard to make a judgment on it”. Stats and Next Steps He finished the game with five receptions for 43 yards. The 2024 rookie set franchise records with 109 receptions in his first season. He also earned Pro Bowl honors that same year before tearing his right ACL in September 2025. Eight games into this year, Nabers has tallied 648 yards along with two touchdowns. The Giants host the Washington Commanders after winning their division. The next game is scheduled for Thursday, Nov. 12, at 8:15 p.m. ET at MetLife Stadium.

item.title: Embrace HIV testing as routine healthcare-Lagos govt urges residents
item.description: . Extends free screening to staff, trade fair visitors By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos State Government has urged residents across the state to embrace HIV testing as part of routine healthcare rather than wait until they suspect an infection before seeking screening. Meanwhile, the state government has extended free HIV testing and counselling services to public servants and visitors to the ongoing 2026 International Trade Fair as part of efforts to promote early diagnosis and expand access to HIV prevention and treatment. The interventions, implemented by the Lagos State AIDS Control Agency (LSACA), are aimed at bringing HIV-related services closer to residents, encouraging routine testing and ensuring that individuals who require further care are linked to appropriate treatment facilities. At the Public Service Week health screening exercise, the Head of Service, Lagos State, Mr Bode Agoro, officially opened the free screening programme and urged public servants to prioritise their health by taking advantage of the opportunity. Agoro said access to preventive healthcare, including HIV screening, was essential to building a healthy, productive and efficient workforce. He encouraged workers to embrace regular health checks and utilise the confidential testing, professional counselling and information on HIV prevention, transmission and treatment provided through the exercise. In a related intervention, LSACA commenced free HIV testing and counselling services at the Lagos Pavilion, Tafawa Balewa Square (TBS), as part of activities at the 2026 International Trade Fair. The exercise, which began on Friday, November 6, is scheduled to run for 10 days, ending on Sunday, November 15. It provides visitors, exhibitors, traders and other participants with access to confidential HIV screening, counselling, preventive health information and guidance on accessing treatment and care where necessary. The Chief Executive Officer of LSACA, Dr Folakemi Animashaun, reaffirmed the state government’s commitment to ensuring that HIV prevention, testing and treatment services remain accessible, confidential and free from discrimination. Animashaun said knowing one’s HIV status was an important step towards preventing new infections and improving health outcomes, noting that early diagnosis enables individuals who test positive to commence treatment promptly and maintain healthy, productive lives. She urged public servants, Trade Fair participants and residents across the state to embrace HIV testing as part of routine healthcare rather than wait until they suspect an infection before seeking screening. The LSACA chief executive also emphasised the importance of collaboration with Ministries, Departments and Agencies, development partners, civil society organisations and other stakeholders in expanding access to HIV prevention, testing, treatment and care services. item.title: New Balance Deal Puts Cooper Flagg Front And Center For Mavs
item.description: Jerome Miron-Imagn Images The Dallas Mavericks named New Balance their official footwear and apparel partner on Monday. This multi-year pact marks the brand’s first-ever partnership with an NBA franchise, signaling a serious shift in how the team builds its identity. While other brands chase star veterans, Dallas is betting everything on the future, specifically tying its fate to rookie Cooper Flagg. The deal covers fan experiences, co-branded gear, and community events throughout the entire season. House of Heat° reported that the agreement creates a direct link between the brand, the team, and Flagg as one of its most prominent athletes. The agreement is a sponsorship and a statement that the organization sees Flagg as the long-term face of the franchise. Mavericks President Ethan Casson made the team’s stance clear when he said, “We’re excited to welcome New Balance to the Mavericks family.” A Fresh Start for Dallas Culture New Balance wants to embed themselves in the local basketball scene rather than just secure a logo placement. Naveen Lokesh, the global director of sports marketing at the company, noted that “Dallas has an incredible basketball culture, and our relationship with the Mavericks gives us an exciting opportunity to become more connected to that community.” The brand already has ties to Flagg through his individual endorsement deal, which makes this team-wide expansion feel like a natural next step. The timing is perfect. SGB Media Online highlighted that the partnership “marks another step in the continued growth of New Balance Basketball, strengthening the brand’s presence in Dallas while creating opportunities to connect with fans through New Balance athlete and Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg.” By aligning with a rookie who is just starting his journey, New Balance is playing the long game rather than chasing quick fame. Immediate Action for Fans The Mavericks and New Balance are not waiting to make their presence felt. On November 8 and 9, the brand organizes a two-day fan event outside the arena to mark the new partnership. SGB Media Online noted that these events feature interactive games, giveaways, and experiences centered around the brand, the Mavericks, and Flagg. This activation takes place right before the team’s back-to-back home games, ensuring maximum visibility. While the deal brings new energy, the team is also focused on winning right now. According to Sports Illustrated , the Mavericks secured a commanding 130-93 victory against the Brooklyn Nets on Sunday evening. This win brought the team’s record to 6-4 across the initial 10 games of the season. The new partnership adds a layer of excitement to a roster that is already showing signs of life under new head coach Dusty May.

item.title: Raiders make deadline blockbuster deal, send Kirk Cousins to Minnesota
item.description: Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins (8) runs the ball for a gain during a NFL regular season game between the Las Vegas Raiders and Miami Dolphins at Allegiant Stadium, Sunday September 13, 2026 in Las Vegas, NV. Just as the clock was about to strike midnight on trade deadline season, the Las Vegas Raiders decided now was the time to make a franchise-altering move. On Tuesday, just before the 4 pm ET deadline, it was reported by ESPN’s Adam Schefter that the Raiders had agreed to a deal to send quarterback Kirk Cousins to the Minnesota Vikings. The Raiders are finalizing a trade to send QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings, per ESPN and NFLN. pic.twitter.com/5uHWGz0OpK — Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) November 10, 2026 The Raiders receive a 2027 third-round pick from the Vikings in exchange. The trade means the start of the Fernando Mendoza era, as Schefter also announced that he was named the starting quarterback for the Raiders moving forward. Cousins ranks fifth in the NFL with 2,340 yards and second with 20 touchdown passes, although he has also thrown for eight interceptions, three of which came in the previous game against the San Francisco 49ers.

Tariq is the Editor-in-Chief of Space.com based out of our New York City office and joined the team in 2001, first as an intern and staff writer, and later as an editor. He covers human spaceflight, exploration and space science, as well as skywatching and entertainment. He became Space.com's Managing Editor in 2009 and Editor-in-Chief in 2019. In October 2022, Tariq received the Harry Kolcum Award for excellence in space reporting from the National Space Club Florida Committee. In June 2025, the National Space Society awarded him the Space Pioneer Award for Excellence in Mass Media at the International Space Development Conference in Orlando, Florida.

Hailing from Stockton, California (where he attended the same high school as NASA astronaut Jose Hernandez), Tariq studied print journalism and astronomy at the University of Southern California in Los Angeles, earning a bachelor's degree in journalism in 1999 along with a minor in astronomy. He then served as a staff reporter for The Los Angeles Times covering education and city beats in La Habra and Fullerton in Orange County for the Our Times sections.

In 2000, Tariq became the city reporter for the Huntington Beach Independent, a weekly publication of the Los Angeles Times, covering local politics and events, crime, business and environmental issues. He left the Los Angeles Times in 2001 to study science journalism at New York University, where he earned a master's degree in 2002 from NYU's Science and Environmental Reporting Program (now the Science, Health and Environmental Reporting Program) under the direction of space reporter William Burrows.

Tariq first joined Space.com as an intern in September 2001 while also serving as a research assistant for nutrition writer Gary Taubes and writing freelance projects, where his work appeared in The Scientist and Laboratory Equipment Magazine. He became a full-time reporter covering spaceflight in 2004, with this first launch being NASA's STS-114 Return to Flight mission in July 2005.

Tariq is also an Eagle Scout (yes, he has the Space Exploration merit badge) and went to Space Camp four times as a kid and a fifth time as an adult. When not writing about space, you can find Tariq watching the latest Star Trek TV series, sci-fi movies and reading about hippos, his favorite animal. item.title: NFL trade deadline news: Raiders trade Kirk Cousins before facing Seahawks
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks haven’t made any trade deadline day moves as of yet, but their Week 10 opponent just made a significant move at the quarterback position. Kirk Cousins is reuniting with the Minnesota Vikings, with the Vikings sending a 2027 third-rounder to the Las Vegas Raiders. Anyone who watched Carson Wentz’s all-time bad game on Monday Night Football against the Buffalo Bills could’ve seen a QB move coming. Blockbuster! The Raiders are trading four-time Pro Bowl QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for their 2027 third-round pick, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports . Cousins returns to Minnesota for the playoff push, while Las Vegas turns to No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza. pic.twitter.com/3SvmtZu6er — Tom Pelissero (@TomPelissero) November 10, 2026 The big story as this pertains to the Seahawks is the fact that Fernando Mendoza, the 2026 No. 1 overall draft pick, Heisman Trophy winner, and national champion is poised to make his first career NFL start. Mendoza’s only regular season action came against the New England Patriots back in Week 5, when he went 6/8 for 48 yards in garbage time of a blowout loss. The former Indiana star represents the future of the Raiders organization, and now he’s their present after a half-season of Cousins. Alternatively, if Klint Kubiak and company have reservations about starting Mendoza right now, veteran Aidan O’Connell is the other QB on the roster. But it looks like the Raiders are pivoting to the rookie against one of the league’s best defenses.

item.title: Why Vikings are reportedly trading for Raiders' Kirk Cousins in blockbuster deal
item.description: Why Vikings are reportedly trading for Raiders' Kirk Cousins in blockbuster deal originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Minnesota Vikings came away from their Monday Night Football loss to the Buffalo Bills in clear disarray. The quarterback problem was too big to ignore. Carson Wentz looked horrible, and Kyler Murray hasn't looked good all season. With an elite defense and great skill players, the Vikings had to make a move for a quarterback. They reportedly have done just that. According to Tom Pelissero of The Ringer , the Vikings are sending the Las Vegas Raiders a third-round pick to acquire Kirk Cousins, reuniting with their former QB in hopes of making a Super Bowl push this season. Why Vikings are trading for Kirk Cousins at NFL trade deadline "Blockbuster! The Raiders are trading four-time Pro Bowl QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for their 2027 third-round pick, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports," Pelissero reports. Trades in the NFL don't make much more sense than this one for the Vikings. There might not be a more obvious trade that a team needed to make in professional sports history. Minnesota's elite defense, Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, and the highly competitive NFC North all made it very apparent that the Vikings needed to make a move for a quarterback. MORE : Myles Garrett shows Rams why they traded for him in return vs. Commanders While they could've tried to land someone like Daniel Jones, it makes far more sense to go out and add Cousins, someone who's familiar with the team, than anyone else. Sending a 2027 third-round pick isn't a horrible trade for the Vikings either, as if this is the move to fix this offense, it's more than worth the price. Cousins is returning to the Vikings and will replace Murray and Wentz atop the team's depth chart to instantly provide a spark to the Vikings. As far as additions at the NFL trade deadline go, this might be as important a trade as there's ever been. Will a mid-season QB addition work? It remains to be seen. But this is a no-brainer trade for the Vikings, and one they had to make with their disastrous QB room. item.title: Deion Sanders says he's 'not getting it done' as Colorado struggles
item.description: Colorado 's disappointing 2026 season continued with a 20-10 loss to Arizona State last weekend that did not feel as close as the final score. Deion Sanders spoke Tuesday on the state of his program after another uninspiring loss. He discussed Colorado's upcoming matchup against No. 16 Houston and the team's widespread offensive struggles, whether he would make a change at offensive coordinator, and he specifically praised his linebacker room. Despite the Buffs' 3-6 record, Sanders remains confident in his staff and players and takes full responsibility for the team's struggles, not throwing any of his staff under the bus, especially struggling offensive coordinator Brennan Marion. Colorado is averaging 19.8 points per game, last in the Big 12 and tied for 123rd out of 138 teams nationally. He also offered high praise for Houston quarterback Conner Weigman, who presents another difficult challenge for Colorado's defense. Sanders did note that there are matchups his team likes against the Cougars Here are a few notable takeaways from Sanders' weekly press conference. Deion Sanders not considering a change at offensive coordinator Deion Sanders has changed offensive play-callers multiple times in his four-year tenure as Colorado's head coach, including last season, when he replaced Pat Shurmur with Brett Bartolone. He gave a firm answer Tuesday when asked about replacing Brennan Marion, simply saying "no." He added later that he has confidence in "everyone," including his coordinators Marion and Chris Marve. Linebacker room continues to be the program's top position group Sanders went out of his way to bring up his linebacker room, a group he called the best position on the team during fall camp. "I remember that room was tremendously criticized last season, and you [the media] haven't applauded it," Sanders said. "I think Coach Hart was attacked last year, right? Applaud him." Sanders also credited Marve for getting the linebackers lined up correctly and in position to make plays. Linebacker Gideon Lampron is coming off back-to-back Big 12 Defensive Player of the Week honors. Deion Sanders takes full blame for recent struggles As he has for most of his tenure, Sanders refuses to blame anyone but himself. He did that again Tuesday, taking full blame for the team's recent struggles. "This is not indicative of who we think we are," Sanders said. "I think the coordinators are doing a phenomenal job, the best they can. The kids are fighting. We’re just not getting it done, I’m not getting it done. Don't say we. I'm soory. Scratch that, I'm not getting it done. All the way around, offensively, defensively, special teams." Deion Sanders gives high praise to Houston QB Conner Weigman Conner Weigman has had an outstanding second year at Houston and is a dynamic dual threat that will be a tough challenge for Colorado's defense. item.title: NFL trade deadline grades: Live analysis for Kirk Cousins, Jordan Davis and more 2026 deadline deals
item.description: NFL trade deadline grades: Live analysis for Kirk Cousins, Jordan Davis and more 2026 deadline deals originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . There used to be crickets around the NFL's midseason trade deadline. That has been replaced by a swarm of cicadas, with teams buzzing about making plenty of deals, big and small. In 2024, the league saw 13 in-season trades. Last year, that number skyrocketed to 22 such trades, with 27 players changing teams. This year, going back to the Giants getting J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings , seven trades were executed before November. Five more have already gone down this month. With the 2026 deadline here on Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET, there is still the expected big splash of a three-time Pro Bowl running back leaving a hard-fading AFC team to a strong contending NFC team. Although Indianapolis has already been busy selling, several other teams, led by Jacksonville, got focused on buying. Here is a breakdown of all the deals, going back to mid-October. LIVE: Follow latest NFL trade rumors, updates NFL trade deadline grades Imagn Images Vikings trade for Raiders QB Kirk Cousins Grade: A+ Minnesota needed to part with only a 2027 third-round pick to make a dramatic upgrade to its struggling quarterback position. Cousins gives the Vikings a familiar option who will go right back to thriving in Kevin O'Connell's system to unlock Justin Jefferson and the rest of the weapons again. He makes the QB situation in the NFC North a lot tighter vs. Jordan Love, Jared Goff and Caleb Williams. Jaguars trade for Falcons S Jessie Bates III Grade: A+ The Jaguars were fully expected to get a safety after Eric Murray (elbow) went down for the season, with rumors swirling most around Derwin James and Budda Baker. Once Bates was available from Atlanta, however, he had to be the move to pair him with Antonio Johnson. item.title: Eddie Howe Could Manage Against Newcastle Next Month
item.description: NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE, ENGLAND - JULY 14: Newcastle United Head Coach Eddie Howe during the second day of pre season training at The Knox on July 14, 2026 in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. (Photo by Serena Taylor/Newcastle United via Getty Images) Newcastle United could find itself facing former head coach Eddie Howe before the end of the year if Manchester United turns to him as its next manager. The Athletic’s David Ornstein, Adam Crafton and Laurie Whitwell reported that Manchester United is expected to sack Michael Carrick before the international break is over, despite the club publicly saying no final decision has been made. “Work has been undertaken on potential replacements and the anticipation is a change will be made before the trip to Anfield to face Liverpool in 13 days’ time,” The Athletic reported. Howe is among the names being considered, with the report stating that the former Newcastle boss and Julian Nagelsmann “have admirers at the club.” USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino is the leading candidate. “United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino would be expected to figure highly among the candidates while former Newcastle United head coach Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann, most recently in charge of Germany, have admirers at the club,“ the report says. That creates the possibility of a very quick reunion between Howe and Newcastle, with the Magpies scheduled to face Manchester United on Dec. 2. If Howe lands the job before then, it would mark his first competitive meeting with Newcastle since leaving St James’ Park in July. There could also be a financial element for Newcastle. The Guardian previously reported that Manchester United would owe the Magpies around £3 million in compensation because of the agreement struck over the remaining terms of Howe’s contract when he departed. How would you feel about seeing Howe on the opposing touchline, let alone Man Utd’s, against Newcastle so soon after his departure? Share your thoughts in the comments. Join the conversation! item.title: Pathetic behaviour from INEOS: Michael Carrick aware of talks behind his back as he continues to take training
item.description: Pathetic behaviour from INEOS: Michael Carrick aware of talks behind his back as he continues to take training INEOS are currently considering a change in the dugout, with Manchester United currently placed in the relegation zone as they head into the international break. The Red Devils produced two trademark comebacks: first against AS Roma in the Champions League, and then versus Aston Villa in the Premier League. However, this has not changed the co-owners’ minds regarding Michael Carrick. As things stand, Mauricio Pochettino is the frontrunner despite his underwhelming interview , but it will not be easy to bring him in before the Liverpool tie. Eddie Howe is another name in contention, with football director Jason Wilcox pushing for the former Newcastle United boss. Carrick set to be axed soon Julian Nagelsmann has turned down United’s proposal , while Unai Emery and Cesc Fabregas are not going anywhere soon. Antonio Conte’s demands have meant talks have not progressed with the Italian. According to Sully , the former United midfielder is aware that INEOS are holding talks with potential replacements behind his back. The word from Old Trafford is that a final decision is yet to be taken, but as almost all outlets have reported, a change is definitely imminent. For now, the 45-year-old is taking training as usual, but for how long remains to be seen. Poor handling from INEOS again “Michael Carrick is aware that Manchester United have spoken with potential replacements, but he has yet to be formally told that he has been dismissed. “Carrick, alongside his coaching staff, oversaw training on Tuesday, with several of United’s first-team players absent on international duty. He will continue working as Manchester United head coach until he’s formally dismissed.” Amidst all this, INEOS could have afforded Michael Carrick a bit more dignity by communicating in a more honest fashion. But as with Erik ten Hag and Ruben Amorim before him, it is clear that the best-in-class hierarchy lacks basic professionalism and humanity. Feature image Carl Recine via Getty Images online polls

item.title: Family affair: Paul Mauck joins father in Tallahassee-Leon Babe Ruth HOF
item.description: For Paul Mauck, the Tallahassee-Leon Babe Ruth Baseball program has never been simply about baseball. It has been about family. Mauck, 70, grew up tagging along with his father, learning the game while watching him umpire locally and at Florida State . He later played TLBR himself, coached alongside his father Paul Mauck, Sr. and eventually coached and watched his three sons play in the league. Now, after roughly 26 years of coaching spread across different stages of his life, Mauck has joined his father in the TLBR Hall of Fame. Mauck, Mitch Englert and Gage West, who also played at Florida State and professionally, were officially inducted and introduced Monday during a TLBR ceremony. "We’re blessed to be a baseball family,” Mauck said. “I grew up around my dad when he was an umpire. I was able to learn the game a lot from going to FSU and watching the players play when he was umpiring. So I kind of fell in love with the game.” The event also introduced the Landon Davis Award , which honored the longtime baseball umpire who was killed in a two-vehicle traffic accident on State Road 73 in Calhoun County on Aug. 11, 2025. Moving forward, the award will be presented annually to the top umpire in TLBR league. TLBR baseball a family affair for Paul Mauck Baseball followed the Mauck family wherever it went. Mauck’s father was in the military, and the family eventually settled in Tallahassee after previously living in California. As a youngster, Mauck routinely tagged along with his father to games. Eventually, following his dad to the ballpark turned into coaching alongside him. After Mauck’s own playing career ended, which included three years in Tallahassee-Leon Babe Ruth, three years as a starter at Godby and one season at Florida State in 1975, his father asked him to help coach his league team in 1978. That began what Mauck describes as the first of several chapters in his coaching career. “I look at it kind of in three phases,” he said. One of the most memorable came in 1998, when Mauck coached alongside his father on a Tallahassee All-Star team that advanced to the Babe Ruth World Series in Pine Bluff, Arkansas and finished third. Mauck’s middle son, Aaron, was on the team, bringing three generations of the family together for the World Series run. All three of Mauck’s sons, Ryan, Aaron and Taylor, played Babe Ruth Baseball. His youngest, Taylor, later followed him into coaching and has worked alongside his father since 2017. Overall, Mauck coached 26 years in TLBR, including 18 as a head coach and 23 as an All-Star coach. He has been part of 11 All-Star teams that reached the Babe Ruth World Series, including the 2025 national championship team. Mauck has also spent the past four years coaching Lincoln’s junior varsity baseball team, winning the City JV Tournament twice. “Paul and his father have been fixtures in the league for 45 years,” veteran TLBR coach Mike Harrison said. “Paul spends countless hours working fields, coaching young men to

item.title: Arrowhead Pride Names Chris Roland-Wallace As Chiefs’ Most Improved Player
item.description: Denny Medley-Imagn Images The Kansas City Chiefs have played eight games, and the season now sits right in the middle. Arrowhead Pride staff members cast votes to pick the team’s most improved player for this point in the year. Nine writers from the outlet each had one vote to decide the winner among several candidates. Defensive back Chris Roland-Wallace won the award with four total votes. He beat out edge rusher Felix Anudike-Uzomah, who received three votes, while Ashton Gillotte and Nohl Williams each took one vote. Roland-Wallace joined the team as a rookie free agent from USC after the 2024 draft. He made the roster in a long-shot bid and quickly became a top special teams player. Grades and Snap Counts Rise Roland-Wallace started the season playing safety while Chamarri Conner recovered from a knee injury. Pro Football Focus gave him a 72.2 grade for his play at safety, which ranks 20th out of 100 players at the position. His coverage grade of 77.6 is even better, placing him sixth among all safeties in that metric. In run defense or open-field situations, he recorded 14 solo tackles. He allows an 84.6% completion percentage in the slot., he limits the damage by giving up only 6.4 yards per completion over eight games. His role grew bigger after veteran L’Jarius Sneed went on the Reserve/Injured list with a chronic knee injury. Roland-Wallace saw his defensive snap count jump above 70% in each of the last two weeks. The on-field results suggest he should keep that workload even if Sneed returns. He plays multiple roles and could build a decent career as a high-end backup for the franchise. Contract Future and Free Agency The Chiefs face a tough decision about Roland-Wallace after this season ends. He will become a restricted free agent (RFA) following the season. For the 2027 offseason, Over the Cap estimates the minimum RFA tender at $3.8 million. Because he went undrafted, Kansas City would not get any draft-pick compensation if he signs with another team. The Chiefs would have the right to match any offer, but other teams might sign him to a deal the Chiefs cannot match. The team is tight against the salary cap, so a modest extension might be the first move in the offseason. Team Health Updates While Roland-Wallace earns the award, the team deals with injuries to key offensive players. Quarterback Patrick Mahomes hurt his elbow against the New York Jets but did not miss a snap. Coach Andy Reid called Mahomes “day-to-day” regarding his availability for the Week 10 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons. Reid said, “Patrick is really day-to-day right now,” while speaking to the media on Monday, according to a report . Xavier Worthy, the wide receiver, and right tackle Jaylon Moore were forced to exit the game due to injuries. Worthy suffered a hamstring tweak, and Moore has an ankle injury. Reid gave them both the same “day-to-day” label. The Chiefs return to practice on Wednesday to see how the players feel before facing the Falcons on Sun

item.title: Red Sox Boss Gives Roman Anthony And Triston Casas The All Clear
item.description: Brad Penner-Imagn Images Red Sox fans watching the injury report now have news. Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow gave a clear update on Roman Anthony and Triston Casas at the GM Meetings in Las Vegas. The team knows both players are healing, and the 2027 season looks much brighter because of it. Breslow said Anthony is still resting but feels good. “I talked to him yesterday, he’s excited about what the offseason will bring,” Breslow said. Sprained right hand sidelined the young outfielder for nearly four months, and the injury was aggravated during the playoffs. Original diagnosis of an aggravated hand sprain alongside surrounding muscle irritation was confirmed by imaging, so surgery was unnecessary. Rest Is The Only Path Forward The plan for Anthony is simple and strict. He will not hit a ball until the doctors say he is fully ready. Breslow noted that at this point they’ve “taken every picture that one can take” of his hand to ensure no hidden issues remain. “Rest, that will be the most important part of the recovery process,” Breslow said. The team will evaluate him again in the next couple of weeks before he starts range of motion and strengthening exercises. This approach makes sense given the history. A partially torn ring finger CMC ligament caused Anthony to miss a chunk of the 2026 season. Pushing him too fast would be a mistake the front office cannot afford.

item.title: ‎States must contribute to pension protection fund to benefit from minimum pension — PenCom DG
item.description: ‎–It is big shame for some state retirees to be paid ₦5,000’ ‎‎By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ‎‎ABUJA — The Director-General of Nigeria’s National Pension Commission (PenCom), Ms. Omolola Bridget Oloworaran, said on Tuesday that states must contribute to the Pension Protection Fund before they can become eligible for the minimum pension. ‎‎She stated this at the official launch of the Minimum Pension Guarantee Scheme and the unveiling of PenCare, a pension industry-funded healthcare initiative designed to provide low-income retirees with access to essential medical services free of charge. ‎‎The event was held at the Old Banquet Hall, Presidential Villa, Abuja. ‎She said about 170,000 retirees are expected to receive the minimum pension of ₦52,500, including those who were previously receiving less than that amount. ‎‎“Every eligible retiree who earns below ₦52,500 will be uplifted to ₦52,500. So, of course, as I said, there is no discrimination if you are within the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS). ‎‎“However, there is an eligibility criterion at the same level. We are making it a requirement that states must contribute to the Pension Protection Fund before they can be eligible for the minimum pension. ‎‎“So, we will work out that modality at the state level because we all know that the fund needs to be sustainable. If people are not contributing, we will run out of funds, and we cannot start a laudable initiative like this and then, years from now, somebody says it has stopped working because people are not contributing. ‎‎“So, we are working on modalities for the states to start contributing. But, as of now, it does not apply only to federal workers. Even private-sector workers are receiving these minimum pensions. ‎‎“As I said in my speech, 54 per cent of the total number of retirees who fall below the minimum pension work in the private sector, even though the private sector is not the majority employer. Essentially, 65 per cent or more of private-sector retirees are earning less than ₦52,500. ‎‎“So, when we tell them to contribute to the Pension Protection Fund, there is a reason for that. They form a large chunk of the money we need.” ‎‎On whether anything was being done to ensure that retirees from states also benefit from the minimum pension, as some of them still receive about ₦5,000 monthly, the PenCom DG said it was shameful to pay someone such an amount, although she doubted whether any state actually paid such a paltry sum. ‎‎“Frankly, that is a big shame. What we have done is that we have started working with the states to ensure that they pay retirement benefits to their retirees and also put a plan in place to review pensionable inflation. ‎‎“I mean, receiving ₦5,000 is unacceptable. I do hope it is not true. I will ask my team to confirm. ‎‎“But ultimately, what we are trying to do is get all the states into the scheme. Once you get into the scheme and start contributing to the Pension Protection Fund, the fund can protect the retiree

item.title: Awujale stool: Adele-in-Council sues Abiodun, challenges reconstituted interregnum committee
item.description: By James Ogunnaike Abeokuta The Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council has dragged the Ogun State Governor, Dapo Abiodun, and members of the reconstituted Awujale Interregnum Administrative Council before the state High Court, Ijebu-Ode, challenging what it described as an unlawful attempt to displace the traditional administrative structure of Ijebuland. Other defendants sued alongside Gov Abiodun are the Attorney General and Commissioner for Justice, the Commissioner for Local Government and Chieftaincy Affairs as well as members of the recently reconstituted Awujale Interregnum Administrative Council including High Chief Rasheed Adesanya, the Olisa of Ijebu Ode, Chief Chris Okunowo, the Bobasuwa, Prof Jide Ajayi, the Jagun Aso, Chief Stephen Bakare, the Babalaje as well as Chief Alade Shote, the Otun Balogun The suit dated November 5, 2026 and marked HCJ/201/2026 according to a statement from the Media office of the Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council and supporting court documents made available to journalists on Tuesday seeks to establish the authority of the Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council to oversee the traditional and administrative affairs of Ijebu-Ode during the interregnum following the transition of the late Awujale of Ijebuland, Oba Sikiru Kayode Adetona. The nine members of the Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council led by the Adele and Ogbeni Oja of Ijebuland, Olorogun Dr Sonny Kuku, are asking the court to declare that the Adele system is the only legitimate traditional administrative authority recognised by the native law, customs and ancestral practices of the Ijebu people during the period between the reigns of successive Awujales. They are also challenging the establishment and subsequent reconstitution of the Awujale Interregnum Administrative Council, describing the arrangement as alien to Ijebu customary law and inconsistent with the Ogun State Chiefs Law. In the substantive suit, the plaintiffs are seeking a declaration that neither the state governor nor the relevant government authorities possess the power to create or reconstitute an administrative council capable of displacing the Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council during an interregnum. They are further asking the court to set aside the purported reconstitution of the AIAC and the appointments of the fifth to eighth defendants, describing the appointments as irregular, illegal, unconstitutional, null and void. The plaintiffs also want a perpetual injunction restraining the governor, the relevant ministries and other government officials from interfering with or bypassing the customary administrative functions of the Adele Oba Awujale-in-Council. Similarly, they are seeking an order restraining the reconstituted Awujale Interregnum Administrative Council from holding meetings, parading themselves or exercising traditional, civil or financial administrative authority over Ijebu-Ode under the disputed AIAC arrangement. item.title: Only Rainbow Coalition can guarantee Tinubu’s victory in Bayelsa – PDP
item.description: By Emem Idio, Yenagoa The Peoples Democratic Party ,PDP, in Bayelsa State has claimed that the Rainbow Coalition is central to President Bola Tinubu’s re-election prospects in the state, pledging to mobilise 300,000 votes for the President in the 2027 general elections. The state PDP chairman and leader of the coalition, Chief George Alabh Turnah, made the declaration in a statement issued by his Senior Special Assistant on Media and Communication, Kevin Loveday-Egbo. Turnah said the coalition would take its campaign for Tinubu’s re-election to communities across the state, with a grassroots mobilisation strategy targeting undecided voters ahead of the 2027 elections. He described the National Rainbow Coalition as a platform for engaging voters, explaining that the group would use its community-level outreach to highlight what it considers the achievements of the Tinubu administration and canvass support for his second term. The PDP chairman said the coalition was committed to expanding its mobilisation network across the state, adding that its target was to secure 300,000 votes for the President. He also challenged the All Progressives Congress, APC, to mobilise an additional 500,000 votes, bringing the combined target of both parties to 800,000 votes. “The Rainbow Coalition has pledged 300,000 votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in Bayelsa State. We are tasking the APC to deliver 500,000 votes to bring the total number of votes for the APC to 800,000 out of the one million, one hundred and fifty thousand Permanent Voter Cards collected in the state,” Turnah said. He said the coalition would intensify its grassroots engagements across Bayelsa as preparations gather momentum for the 2027 general elections.
